#### E-Resources

Ardhi University Library subscribes e-resources through COTUL (Consortium of Tanzania University and Research Libraries). The Library provides access to 4 journals databases, 45 open access journals and 4 electronic book (e-book) databases. 

The following is a list of subscribed databases accessed at ARU Library and their Uniform Resource Locator (URLs):

  1. EBSCOhost
  2. Sage Journals
  3. Emerald Insight
  4. Research4life

The following list entails some Open Access Journals accessed at ARU Library and their Uniform Resource Locator (URLs):

  1. American Institute of Physics journals
  2. American Physical Society
  3. British Institute of Radiology Journals
  4. Canadian Science Publishing (publisher of the NRC Research Press journals)
  5. De Gruyter LIS Books
